say:1:1062003001:1.text: You brought a letter from Erlan?!
say:1:1062003001:1.source_cn: 哎？你带来了依尔兰的信？！
say:1:1062003001:1.male: You brought a letter from Erlan?!
say:1:1062003001:1.female: You brought a letter from Erlan?!

say:2:1062003002:1.text: Holy Deer Spirit! This IS Erlan's handwriting!
say:2:1062003002:1.source_cn: ……鹿灵在上，真的是依尔兰的字迹！
say:2:1062003002:1.male: Holy Deer Spirit! This IS Erlan's handwriting!
say:2:1062003002:1.female: Holy Deer Spirit! This IS Erlan's handwriting!

say:3:1062003003:1.text: You must've come a very long way. Taran to Slopeville is quite the distance.
say:3:1062003003:1.source_cn: 塔兰村和南坡村离得这么远，真是辛苦你特地来一趟了。
say:3:1062003003:1.male: You must've come a very long way. Taran to Slopeville is quite the distance.
say:3:1062003003:1.female: You must've come a very long way. Taran to Slopeville is quite the distance.

say:5:1062003004:1.text: Ah, you must be a mage. I envy you. If I could use the Waystone, Erlan wouldn't have to worry about me so much.
say:5:1062003004:1.source_cn: 原来你是魔法师呀！真羡慕你，要是我也能使用传送石，依尔...

say:6:1062003005:1.text: I'll take some time to figure out my reply. Don't worry about delivering it. I'll do it myself.
